title: Assessing the Case for Africa-Centric AI Safety Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct empirical measurements, but proposes a taxonomy and threat modeling techniques (e.g., reference class forecasting, structured expert elicitation, scenario planning, and system-theoretic process analysis) to evaluate the 'portability gap' and severe risks caused by distributional shifts when AI systems trained and evaluated in Western contexts are deployed in African environments.

Recommends adapting AI safety evaluation frameworks to test models against realistic language inputs, low-resource linguistic environments, and patterns of code-switching specific to African deployment contexts.
